pages: IMPORTANT • Please reference 38MURA Installation Instructions for complete instruction. This document provides additional wiring scenarios based on the indoor unit being installed to. • Please read the entire instructions manual before starting the installation.

38MURA CROSSOVER SOLUTIONS •Compatible with most Comfort and Performance fan coils and furnaces with both A and N type coils •Capacity Ranges: 1.5T, 2T, 2.5T, 3T, 4T & 5T •Available in regular heat and high heat options •Utilizes standard line set sizes (insulation of suction line only), integrated 24V interface connection

COMPATIBILITY Fan Coils FB4CN FX4DN FMA4X FJ4DN PF4MN FZ4AN FM(C,U) FV4CN FMA4P Furnaces 58S(B,C) 58SP* 58SU* 58TP* 59SC2 59SC5 59SP* 59TP* 59SU* OVL OVM Depending on size, 38MURA is compatible with the following fan coils and furnaces. Refer to MyCarrierRatings to access all compatible combinations and performance information.

38MURA WITH APPROVED SINGLE-STAGE FURNACES Applies To: • 59SU-ULTRA LOW NOX • 58S(B,C)& 59SC-COMFORT SERIES Notes: • ‘O/B' ENERGIZED ON HEATING • 'Y1' TERMINAL AT OUTDOOR UNIT MAY OPTIONALLY BE USED INSTEAD OF ‘Y2’ FOR A SLOWER COMPRESSOR "RAMP-UP" RATE • MUST USE DUAL FUEL THERMOSTAT FOR ALL FURNACE COMBINATIONS. SIMULTANEOUS HEAT PUMP AND FURNACE OPERATION NOT PERMITTED. • REFER TO INDOOR UNIT LITERATURE FOR ADDITIONAL INFORMATION

38MURA WITH APPROVED SINGLE/TWO STAGE FURNACES Applies To: • 58SP,59SP-PERFORMANCE SERIES • 58SU-ULTRA LOW NOX • 58TP & 59TP-PERFORMANCE SERIES • OVL and OVM Oil Furnaces Notes: • O/B' ENERGIZED ON HEATING • 'Y1' TERMINAL AT OUTDOOR UNIT MAY OPTIONALLY BE USED INSTEAD OF ‘Y2’ FOR A SLOWER COMPRESSOR "RAMP-UP" RATE • MUST USE DUAL FUEL THERMOSTAT FOR ALL FURNACE COMBINATIONS. SIMULTANEOUS HEAT PUMP AND FURNACE OPERATION NOT PERMITTED. • REFER TO INDOOR UNIT LITERATURE FOR ADDITIONAL INFORMATION

38MURA WITH APPROVED SINGLE SPEED FAN COIL Applies To: • FMA4 Notes: • O/B' ENERGIZED ON HEATING • 'Y1' TERMINAL AT OUTDOOR UNIT MAY OPTIONALLY BE USED INSTEAD OF ‘Y2’ FOR A SLOWER COMPRESSOR "RAMP-UP" RATE. • REFER TO INDOOR UNIT LITERATURE FOR ADDITIONAL INFORMATION

38MURA WITH APPROVED SINGLE SPEED FAN COILS Applies To: • FJ4 • FB4C • FX4D • PF4M Notes: • O/B' ENERGIZED ON HEATING • 'Y1' TERMINAL AT OUTDOOR UNIT MAY OPTIONALLY BE USED INSTEAD OF ‘Y2’ FOR A SLOWER COMPRESSOR "RAMP-UP" RATE. • REFER TO INDOOR UNIT LITERATURE FOR ADDITIONAL INFORMATION

38MURA WITH APPROVED TWO SPEED FAN COIL Applies To: • FV4CN(B,F) Notes: • O/B' ENERGIZED ON HEATING • RECOMMEND ‘HP-EFF’ SETTING ON EASY SELECT BOARD • OPTIONAL HUMIDIFICATION AND DEHUMIDIFICATION SETUP NOT SHOWN. REFER TO INDOOR UNIT LITERATURE FOR ADDITIONAL INFORMATION • 'Y1' TERMINAL AT OUTDOOR UNIT MAY OPTIONALLY BE USED INSTEAD OF ‘Y2’ FOR A SLOWER COMPRESSOR "RAMP-UP" RATE. • REFER TO INDOOR UNIT LITERATURE FOR ADDITIONAL INFORMATION

38MURA WITH APPROVED TWO SPEED FAN COIL Applies To: • FZ4ANP Notes: • O/B' ENERGIZED ON HEATING • 'Y1' TERMINAL AT OUTDOOR UNIT MAY OPTIONALLY BE USED INSTEAD OF ‘Y2’ FOR A SLOWER COMPRESSOR "RAMP-UP" RATE. • REFER TO INDOOR UNIT LITERATURE FOR ADDITIONAL INFORMATION

38MURA WITH APPROVED SINGLE SPEED FAN COIL Applies To: • FMC Notes: • O/B' ENERGIZED ON HEATING • SIMULTANEOUS HEAT PUMP AND ELECTRIC HEATING NOT ALLOWED • REFERENCE INDOOR UNIT LITERATURE FOR ADDITIONAL INFORMATION ON USE OF DROPOUT RELAY • HEAT PUMP THERMOSTAT MUST BE USED. CONVENTIONAL THERMOSTAT NOT PERMITTED • DO NOT USE "W" TERMINAL AT ODU • 'Y1'TERMINAL AT OUTDOOR UNIT MAY OPTIONALLY BE USED INSTEAD OF 'Y2' FOR A SLOWER COMPRESSOR "RAMPUP" RATE.
